entities.name: Robenílson Vieira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robenílson Vieira de Jesus is an amateur boxer from Brazil who won a silver medal at the 2011 Pan American Games. He competed at the 2008, 2012 and 2016 Summer Olympics, but did not win a medal on either of the three occasions.
